newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold easier, boosting demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold easier, boosting demand.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange rose sharply to 1,510 kg on Tuesday from Monday's 850 kg as lower prices boosted demand, dealers said.
Gold closed easier at $325.00 an ounce and 1,689,000 lira per gram compared to $325.50 and 1,693,500 lira on Monday, in line with lower levels on European markets.
The Turkish lira closed weaker at 162,200 to the dollar, versus the previous close of 161,980.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,185 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 65.8 percent conducted in dollar terms.
